Goodwill Goodwill represents the excess of the total consideration transferred over the fair value of net identifiable assets acquired in a business combination. Goodwill is not amortized but is tested for impairment annually as of December 31 of each fiscal year, or more frequently if events or circumstances indicate that the carrying value may not be recoverable. The Company operates as a single reporting unit. The Company first performs a qualitative assessment to determine whether it is more likely than not that the fair value of the reporting unit is less than its carrying value ("Step 0"). If Step 0 indicates that a quantitative test is required, the Company compares the fair value of the reporting unit to its carrying value.
